note: SAMPLE listings for UI prototyping only. Not real events: organizers and places are generic on purpose. Replace with real local events later.

events.title: Gentle morning walk
events.whatToExpect: An easy-paced walk of about 45 minutes on flat paths, with a stop halfway. Come in comfortable shoes and bring water. You can turn back at any point.

events.title: Easy walk-run evening
events.whatToExpect: Mix walking and light jogging at your own pace. Walkers are welcome the whole way. The group waits at the end so nobody is left behind.

events.title: Nordic walking for beginners
events.whatToExpect: A short introduction to walking with poles, then a slow loop together. Poles can be borrowed for the first session.

events.title: Sunrise loop
events.whatToExpect: One quiet loop before the day starts, about 30 minutes. Coffee nearby afterwards for anyone who wants it.

events.title: Pétanque afternoon
events.whatToExpect: Friendly games in small teams. Boules are shared, and someone will show you the rules if you are new.

events.title: Tai chi in the park
events.whatToExpect: Slow, flowing movements done standing, led step by step. Stand at the back and follow along, or watch first.

events.title: Seated stretch class
events.whatToExpect: A relaxed class done mostly from a chair. Chairs are provided. Wear clothes you can move in.

events.title: Lawn bowls taster
events.whatToExpect: Try a few ends with club members. Flat-soled shoes please; bowls are provided.

events.title: Coffee and a stroll
events.whatToExpect: Meet for coffee, then a short stroll around the square for those who want to. Easy to join on your own.

events.title: Line dancing social
events.whatToExpect: Simple steps taught slowly, then a few songs together. No partner needed. Sit out any song you like.

events.title: Board games afternoon
events.whatToExpect: Card and board games at shared tables. Bring a favourite game or learn a new one.

events.title: Community garden morning
events.whatToExpect: Light jobs around the beds, done at your own pace, with a tea break. Gloves and tools are shared.
